generated on 2026-09-26 during the premium-site continuation review. The original
fixture SHA-256 was
`ea763b246a9ee077a00ce223922258824525b97f8125929f76dc546fa686c5ef`.

The portable fixture retains the full 52-lesson semantic and exercise snapshots,
